title: Source signal story rollup
summary: This iteration adds a deterministic reader-facing source signal story before the source metrics dashboard. The rollup turns public source_effectiveness rows, visible story topics, included source names, updated-but-not-selected sources, and explicit source gaps into one concise section while preserving the fixed-order full source inventory and avoiding internal audit data exposure.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source-first IA dashboard|source-first IA status focus|source inventory|source signal story rollup" tests/unit.test.js

Playwright visual check: desktop 1280x900 and mobile 390x844 on docs/reports/2026/06/2026-06-29.html; screenshots .tmp/phase12-source-signal-story-desktop.png and .tmp/phase12-source-signal-story-mobile.png

lessons.lesson: A source-first daily page needs a reader-facing source narrative before operational metrics so source coverage is perceived as the main content rather than a backstage audit.
lessons.evidence: `reportToInteractionInput()` now emits `source-signal-story` before `source-first-dashboard`, and unit/E2E checks assert that ordering and content.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future first-screen source summaries deterministic and derived from public `source_effectiveness`, `stories`, and `main_items` fields unless a separate public editorial generation contract is added.

lessons.lesson: Public source summaries must name both productive sources and gaps without reintroducing private collection internals.
lessons.evidence: The new rollup lists included, updated-not-selected, blocked, and not-configured/skipped source names, while tests reject `source_audit`, candidate, snapshot, env var, debug, and private-note leakage.
lessons.recommended_action: For every future source summary field, add one positive assertion for reader-visible value and one negative assertion for internal field leakage.

lessons.lesson: The source story should complement, not replace, fixed-order source proof surfaces.
lessons.evidence: Generated HTML keeps `source-first-dashboard`, `source-status-focus`, `source-inventory`, inventory finder behavior, and all 154 source rows after adding the story rollup.
lessons.recommended_action: Treat the story rollup as the short lead-in; keep detailed status, map, and inventory sections as the audit trail for source availability.

followups.action: Refine first-viewport hierarchy after user review by deciding how much of the story rollup should appear above the fold versus behind source navigation anchors.
